name: Extra EA-300
summary: German world-class unlimited aerobatic monoplane with a composite wing and tube-and-fabric fuselage; flown by airshow and competition pilots worldwide.

wings: Thin, straight cantilever monoplane wing, mid-set (low-set on the 300L) with no flaps
Long ailerons covering most of the trailing edge
engines: Six-cylinder Lycoming in a tight cowl
fuselage: Tandem cockpits under a long bubble canopy on the two-seat models; single seat on the S and LC
Slim fuselage tapering to the tail
Fixed tailwheel gear with composite spring legs
tail: Large rudder and fin with big elevators

tellTales: Single-wing aerobatic taildragger with a long bubble canopy and three-blade prop
Thin straight wing with huge ailerons and no flaps
Tight cowl over a six-cylinder engine with composite spring gear

confusedWith.howToTell: The Pitts is a tiny biplane; the Extra is a monoplane with a long single wing.
The Edge is a single-seater with an all-composite smooth fuselage; most Extras are two-seaters with a fabric-covered rear fuselage.
The XA42 is a newer all-composite airframe with a different cowl, canopy and wing-root shape; the Extra 300 has a fabric-covered rear fuselage.
The Yak-55 has a radial engine with a rounded cowl; the Extra has a flat-six with a tight, narrow cowl.
